paragraphs: A multi-engine translator across 200 languages — open models on your own server, or cloud models with your own key, all from one clean UI.

paragraphs: A chat frontend for KeyLM-75M-Instruct, a 75M-parameter instruction-tuned model.

The model is served by a small inference API. The page wakes it as soon as it opens — the service sleeps when idle, so the first visit after a quiet period takes a moment before it starts answering — and keeps full multi-turn history, trimmed to the model's 2048-token context as the conversation fills.

Every reply reports how it was produced: output tokens, latency, and the decode rate measured inside the server's generation loop. That rate excludes prompt processing, so it describes the speed of the reply itself rather than the round-trip.

repositories.name: PDACmod
repositories.description: KRAS/SMAD4 virtual screening for pancreatic cancer

paragraphs: Pancreatic cancer remains one of the deadliest malignancies, with a five-year survival rate of just 13%. Due to a lack of reliable early biomarkers and investigative approaches, it is frequently diagnosed at an advanced stage. Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma (PDAC) often metastasizes early due to complex interactions between cell-autonomous processes and the tumour microenvironment.

The KRAS protein, a 21 kDa small GTPase, acts as an on-off switch in the GTPase cycle, converting GTP (on) to GDP (off). In approximately 95% of PDAC cases, mutations such as KRAS G12D lock the protein in a permanently active state, persistently triggering the MAPK pathway. This constant signalling drives uncontrolled cell division, inhibits apoptosis, and contributes to angiogenesis and immune evasion.

Research indicates that the combined genomic alterations of KRAS and the loss of SMAD4 influence tumour biology and therapeutic vulnerabilities. Specifically, the loss of SMAD4 causes TGF-β to switch from a tumour suppressor to a tumour promoter, suggesting that blocking both KRAS and SMAD4 holds high therapeutic potential.

repositories.name: Model Genome Korea
repositories.description: DNA lineage test of Korean LLM & VLM foundation models

paragraphs: Model Genome Korea is a free, interactive tool that reveals the architectural lineage ("DNA") of every major Korean sovereign AI foundation model. It genotypes each Korean large language model (LLM) and vision-language model (VLM) — measured directly from public config.json files and model weights on Hugging Face — to show, objectively, which Korean AI models are built from scratch and which are derived from foreign open-weight bases like Qwen, Llama, or DeepSeek.

The tool covers foundation models from 9 Korean organizations that released self-developed foundation models on Hugging Face: LG AI Research (EXAONE), SKT (A.X), Upstage (SOLAR), NCSOFT (VARCO), NAVER (HyperCLOVA X), Kakao (Kanana), KT (Mi:dm), Motif Technologies (Motif), and VIDRAFT (AETHER) — spanning large enterprises, telcos, mid-size firms, and startups.

Model Genome Korea is an architecture-provenance explorer for Korean sovereign AI. Like a genetic paternity test for neural networks, it fingerprints each model's architecture and weights and reports a genotype — a single, at-a-glance label describing how original (or derived) the model is. Every value is measured from public artifacts, so the results are reproducible and vendor-neutral. This is a transparency tool, not an accusation: building on open-weight foundations (Qwen, Llama, DeepSeek, Mistral) is a standard and legitimate engineering practice across the industry.

Four models (LogisticRegression, RandomForest, GradientBoosting, XGBoost) are tuned, achieving >97% accuracy, with the best model deployed in a Flask web app. The app features a modern, healthcare-themed UI with a search bar for easy symptom selection, making it user-friendly for early disease diagnosis.

Model Training: GridSearchCV tunes four models, selecting the best (e.g., Logistic Regression) with >97% accuracy on 42-class classification.
Web App: Flask app with a responsive UI, including:
Symptom selection form (40–50 checkboxes).
Real-time symptom search bar (JavaScript).
